meta.title: Aftercare — Cottage Aesthetics
meta.description: General aftercare guidance for treatments at Cottage Aesthetics. Personalised aftercare is provided at every appointment.

pageHero.title: Aftercare
pageHero.tag: Great results continue at home. You'll always receive personalised aftercare at your appointment — this is a general guide.

draftFlag: General guidance only — Purdi to confirm the exact, treatment-specific aftercare wording before launch. Your personalised aftercare is always given in clinic.

first24h.title: In the first 24 hours
first24h.item1: Avoid touching, rubbing or applying pressure to the treated area.
first24h.item2: Keep the area clean and avoid makeup where advised.
first24h.item3: Avoid strenuous exercise, saunas, steam rooms and very hot showers.
first24h.item4: Skip alcohol and stay well hydrated.

followingDays.title: Over the following days
followingDays.item1: Protect the skin with a broad-spectrum SPF and avoid direct sun / sunbeds.
followingDays.item2: Avoid facials, exfoliation or active skincare until advised it's safe.
followingDays.item3: Some redness, swelling or tenderness can be normal and usually settles quickly.

whenToContact.title: When to get in touch
whenToContact.body: If you have any concerns at all after your treatment, please contact Purdi straight away — you're never left to wonder. Your safety and comfort always come first.
